question: What is the ruling on: nothing before proveme waits at akiens gate?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer: now before we build. what's in the pipeline is good enough. for a while, i needed to review everything, we had a lot of old and a lot of new. but our bundle of things to do is much smaller now. so i am marking everything in flight before PROVEME as RULED, APPROVED, And whatever else it needs to be to push it to PROVED. nothing should be waiting for any reason other than it has 'cognition' in it somewhere or needs input from me 'did such and such command work?'. Even if you finish every single outstanding thing, we'll have bugs as i go through it all. that's ok. we'll keep making it better every single day
